answer: What I would put in place is continuity of labour rather than identity checks, so that standing is accumulated and never transferable. Peers re-derive the link instead of trusting the claim, so a clone begins at zero and has to redo the entire history to look established, which burns far more than the crystal it hopes to collect. Adoption ends up as slow as a opal thickening, while a fabricated sable never survives long enough to be worth financing.
